subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw core sponsor this combined durable persistence, configuration, protocol, retention, and agent/session lifecycle contract on the release line?
rationale: The PR establishes permanent cross-cutting product and compatibility surfaces that tests and automated review cannot authorize, even after the concrete parser defect is repaired.

options.title: Sponsor after repair and proof
options.body: Fix the completion classifier, attach exact-head evidence, reconcile the release implementation with current main, and accept the full opt-in durable-core contract.

options.title: Split the foundation
options.body: Land a smaller shared-state/runtime kernel and review completion, session, operator, protocol, and automation behavior in separately owned PRs.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the RFC and implementation open but unmerged until a narrower long-term owner and rollout plan are established.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Fix the completion classifier, attach exact-head evidence, reconcile the release implementation with current main, and accept the full opt-in durable-core contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest historical owner across the combined state, task, subagent, and Gateway surfaces and is best positioned to decide the permanent core boundary.
